transport.cli_input: strict UTF-8 binary stdin; strict UTF-8 or BOM-marked UTF-16 files; Unicode Windows argv; no replacement decoding
transport.cli_admission: not_accepted/none for local rejection; rejected/none for explicit pre-admission HTTP rejection; unknown/unknown after a lost submission acknowledgement
transport.modal_actions: exact inspected dialog/button IDs and bounded explicit text values; separate idempotency receipts, same Qt modal loop

captured_columns.columns: actual common visible labels in visual header order
captured_columns.columns_by_track: only unambiguous actual displayed row values
captured_columns.columns_by_occurrence: exact repeated playlist occurrence row values
captured_columns.missing_values: explicit CONTEXT_REQUIRED; never another row's values
captured_columns.capture_policy: only expressions using columnNames/columnValues capture context; names capture labels only; oversized values fail CONTEXT_LIMIT before HTTP without truncation
